WITH up AS (
  INSERT INTO candidate_profile
    (id, display_name, target_roles, skills, must_have, avoid_keywords,
     experience_years, preferred_locations, work_modes, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (1, $1,
     ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb)),
     ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($3::jsonb)),
     ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($4::jsonb)),
     ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($5::jsonb)),
     $6::numeric,
     ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($7::jsonb)),
     ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($8::jsonb)),
     now())
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name,
    target_roles = EXCLUDED.target_roles,
    skills = EXCLUDED.skills,
    must_have = EXCLUDED.must_have,
    avoid_keywords = EXCLUDED.avoid_keywords,
    experience_years = EXCLUDED.experience_years,
    preferred_locations = EXCLUDED.preferred_locations,
    work_modes = EXCLUDED.work_modes,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id, display_name, target_roles, skills, must_have, avoid_keywords,
            experience_years::float8 AS experience_years,
            preferred_locations, work_modes, updated_at
)
SELECT json_build_object('profile', row_to_json(up)) AS data FROM up;
